references.text: Moses tells of God's miraculous provision of manna to the children of Israel in the wilderness, which mirrors Jesus' miraculous feeding of the four thousand in Mark 8:9.
Jesus feeds five thousand men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish, a similar miracle to what happens in Mark 8:9.
Jesus feeds four thousand men, plus women and children, with seven loaves and a few small fish, which is the direct event referred to in Mark 8:9.
Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves and two fish, a similar miracle to what happens in Mark 8:9.
